data: Does the KVRN model consistently outperform the MANN/MD model across all memory sizes?

The KVRN model consistently outperforms the MANN/MD model across all memory sizes. This can be observed in both graphs (a) SMTD and (b) CamRest. In graph (a), the blue line representing KVRN is always above the orange line representing MANN/MD. Similarly, in graph (b), the blue line for KVRN is consistently higher than the orange line for MANN/MD. The green line for MANN+MD is also higher than the orange line for MANN/MD in both graphs, indicating that the KVRN model performs better than the MANN/MD model across all memory sizes.
